title: 2019 AMC 12A Problem 4
statement: What is the greatest number of consecutive integers whose sum is \(45?\)

solutions.text:
Negative integers are allowed. The integers from \(-44\) to \(44\) sum to \(0,\) so the integers from \(-44\) to \(45\) sum to \(45.\)

This run has \(45 - (-44) + 1 = 90\) integers. Conversely, if \(L\) consecutive integers have sum \(45,\) then twice their sum is \(L\) times an integer, so \(90\) is a multiple of \(L.\) Hence \(L\le90,\) proving that this run is longest.

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: The integers are allowed to be negative
Adding \(-44, -43, \ldots, 44\) contributes \(0,\) so extend the run just past \(45\)
